why: Every place AutoMode is listed or will be submitted, with its rules and what it did. Read it before any submission, so nothing is sent twice. The growth skill updates it.

entries.name: Anthropic plugin directory
entries.rules: Official submission form. Anthropic reviews quality and security. The `directory` branch passed validation in #16.
entries.notes: Submission state unknown. `claude plugin list --available` did not show AutoMode on 2026-10-31.

entries.name: hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code
entries.rules: Web issue form only, never a PR and never gh. A human must submit. The repo must be 14 days old (from 2026-11-10) or have 100 stars. One resource at a time. One descriptive line, no sales pitch, no emoji.

entries.name: karanb192/awesome-claude-code-mods (catalogue)
entries.rules: A scanner finds repos with the claude-code-mod topic. A seed PR is only for repos it misses.
entries.notes: Not in data/repos.txt or catalogue.md on 2026-11-05. A search for 'automode' matches the unrelated mod 'automodel', so search for 'mralexivy'. #446 is the one seed PR. #444 was closed as its duplicate.

entries.name: karanb192/awesome-claude-code-mods (Featured)
entries.rules: Nomination issue: mod URL, the task it helps with, a real recording, install steps, access notes, Claude Code version and platform. Disclose authorship.

entries.name: quemsah/awesome-claude-plugins
entries.rules: A crawler indexes every plugin repository (54,226 on 2026-11-01) and the README shows the top 100 by stars. All merged PRs are the owner's own. There is no submission path.
entries.notes: AutoMode enters the top 100 only by stars. Its site, awesomeclaudeplugins.com, lists indexed repos.

entries.name: composio-community/awesome-claude-plugins
entries.rules: It hosts each plugin's code in its own repository and merged 1 of its last 30 closed PRs.
entries.notes: Not a list of outside repositories.

entries.name: claude-market/marketplace
entries.rules: A submission copies the plugin's code into its repository as a top-level directory.
entries.notes: A copied mod would go stale on every release, and the list has 27 stars.

entries.name: jqueryscript/awesome-claude-code

entries.notes: Leave it alone. Do not ping.

entries.notes: Account mralexivy has 1 karma. Planned for Tuesday 8:37am ET so a weekday morning gives it a fair start.

entries.name: r/ClaudeAI
entries.rules: Read the subreddit rules on self-promotion before posting. State authorship.
entries.notes: AutoModerator filtered the post: the account is new and has 1 karma. A modmail asking for review was sent 2026-11-05. Rules allow Built with Claude posts that say how Claude helped and that the project is free. Use the Built with Claude flair.
